{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MC-009","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"title","page":1,"quote":"SHAFT-3"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"NOTE:- 1)TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-30 HRc. 2)REMOVE ALL SHARP EDGES & CORNERS. 3)ALL KEYWAY ARE IN LINE & SHOULD BE DONE IN ONE SETTING. 4) STRAIGHTNESS:- 0.2mm/1000mm MAX. 5) RUNOUT:- 0.1mm/1000mm."}],"comment":"The drawing identifies the part as a shaft (title 'SHAFT-3') and specifies tight straightness and runout tolerances in note N3, which typically require turning between centres, yet no centre holes are specified. Without centre holes the machinist cannot reliably hold the shaft to achieve these geometric tolerances. The designer should add centre hole callouts at both ends of the shaft."
    ,"recommended_correction":"Add centre hole specifications (e.g., per ISO 6411 or equivalent) at both ends of the shaft."}]}
